findings.claim: The original 57-point inherited Crusader closure is not restricted to an obsolete Crusader49 wallet after becoming Paladin. Original final goals independently close to 16 skills: Swordman10 prerequisite points already covered by first49, Crusader57 and Paladin10; final second-job spend67 of69, complete at Paladin job68. Do not reinterpret the 77-point goals-only closure as one pool or erase first-job requirements.

A single status.skill_point does not grant unrestricted early access. With player_skillup_limit=yes and player_skillfree=no, paid novice points must reach9, then paid points after subtracting9 must reach change_level_2nd-1 before second-job tree normalization. Native jobchange records actual first-job change level. Candidate paid Basic9+first49 meets both gates before Paladin; inherited Crusader skills then draw from the same available points, with tree max/prerequisite/base/job checks. These gates do not impose a separate49 ceiling on inherited Crusader skills after Paladin access. Reset and earlier-first-skill spending need stage-aware handling.

First49 sequence and nontrans Crusader49 sequence independently replay without prerequisite/cap errors. Both reborn variants consume67/69 and finish at job68; party variant breakdown is Crusader62+Paladin5, not57+10; solo is57+10. Each of the three final67-point sequences was replayed on the actual Paladin inherited tree, with learned Basic9/High Swordman49 carried in. Entries have no positive declared base/job gates; a base99 witness is legal, but experience gains or optimal base/job co-progression were not simulated. Two remaining points are discretion within the actual Paladin tree and caps, not arbitrary skill/class grants.

Native IDs independently evaluated:0,1,14,4001,4002,4015; source max jobs10,50,50,10,50,70 and max base99. Valkyrie checks BaseLevel>98, JobLevel>49 and eligible normal second class; Weight=0,Zeny=0,no cart/falcon/riding and SkillPoint=0 precede change to High Novice/resetlvl(1). Paid skills and stats reset, base/job become1, skill wallet0, stats1 and initial stat points100. Quest skills are exceptional: quest_skill_reset=no means not every old quest skill is wiped; High Swordman grants three quest skills. The checked Valkyrie branch has no explicit checkpet predicate: dialogue mentioning pets is not proof of an executable pet gate. Paladin NPC requires ADVJOB=Paladin, Class=High Swordman, job40+, SkillPoint=0; candidate waits for50. F_CanChangeJob checks Basic9 under basicskillcheck. Source path legality is conditional on quests and imports, not proof of executed changes.

Independent summed pre-re incremental costs and cumulative curve differences reproduce original975 cost, normal base99 budget1273 and reborn1325, residuals298/350, and earliest reborn budget availability base82. Example1240 leaves85; alternative1487 exceeds1325. Omitted AGI/LUK are explicitly assumed base1, not inferred intended endpoint. No variant spends the residual or silently replaces user stat goals. Actual class-specific cap lookup must preserve job-db MaxStats/import precedence; public configured normal/trans defaults are99.

All15 raw exact-name item candidates match the research projection. Six of seven display names are ambiguous; Cross Shield2130 alone is unique. Native job masks use distinct first/2-1/2-2 positions, so Swordman permission alone cannot imply Paladin permission; these actual candidates explicitly allow Crusader or All. Omitted Classes defaults All and Gender defaults Both; present-null declarations must not be normalized to omission. All15 candidates permit Paladin upper branch under static public metadata. Blade candidates are 1hSword/Right_Hand and do not conflict with Cross Shield/Left_Hand; native overlapping slot equipping displaces prior items. Cross Shield requires base80 and not High Swordman. Rosary variants min bases20/90/1 and Rosary_C trade restrictions must remain distinct. None is silently selected. Status/broken/map restrictions, scripts/cards/refines are not proven by static compatibility.

All recorded shop rows and46 ordinary Drops rows reproduce exactly. Cross Shield source regular drop is mob1919/Rate15, and moc_fild21 spawn line314 exists (other source maps also exist). Shop default -1/database Buy is not a live market tier. The broader all-drop completeness claim has one omission: Boots_2406 in Stormy Knight1251 MvpDrops Rate500. Independent all-category projection yields47 rows, not46. MVP reward rows should be labeled separately from ordinary loot, never inserted as an equivalent live probability. Recorded ordinary-drop examples remain supported; no map access, episode import, NPC shop runtime, farm feasibility or actual item acquisition was verified.

Current template keeps original skills/stat goals/class path/equipment/milestones unchanged; adapter only aliases Swordsman to Swordman and exact display-name ambiguity already fails closed. High Novice/High Swordsman literals unresolved; milestone base70 cannot represent the earlier base99 rebirth and cannot equip base80 Cross Shield. Future TDD integration must represent life/class/base/job, normalization and real per-stage spend/rebirth, explicit native identities and acquisition availability. No build executor, equipment receipt, gameplay, damage model, private-import equivalence or whole-class coverage approval.
